sub.risk: Returns, parcels refused at the door, cancelled orders, high-risk orders, courier claims and support tickets by place. Counts only: nothing here blocks, holds or changes an order.
sub.money: What delivery brings in against what the courier charges, profit of the orders whose cost is known, ad spend by district and the styles that sell. Figures only: no charge, budget, price or stock is changed.
sub.demand: New against repeat customers, wishlist adds and searches that ended without a sale, and the style to push. Counts only: no name or phone.

geoLenses.hidden: Some parts are left out because your role may not see them.
geoLenses.empty: No figures for this period and place.
geoLenses.failed: This lens could not be loaded. Try again.

advisor.title: AI advisor
advisor.sub: Reads the figures of the lenses that are on and drafts suggestions into the approval queue. Advice only: it changes no budget, campaign, price, charge, COD rule or courier.
advisor.off: The advisor could not be loaded. Try again.
advisor.aiOff: AI is switched off, so the advisor cannot run.
advisor.needControl: Running the advisor needs the AI control permission.
advisor.ready: Ready. One run drafts a few suggestions for the period shown above.
advisor.result: {drafted} drafted, {waiting} already waiting, {over} left out over the limit, {nonote} left out without an AI note.
advisor.failed: The advisor could not run. Try again.
